instruction: Implement Conway's Game of Life on a toroidal grid in PascalABC.NET using GraphWPF with optimization through uniform grid hashing. The program should handle cell updates efficiently and display generation information.
Demonstrate the use of LinkedList from System.Collections.Generic in PascalABC.NET, including adding elements, copying to array, and inserting elements using Find method.
Create PascalABC.NET programs demonstrating LINQ operations including generating sequences, mathematical ranges, and character ranges.
Implement prime number generation in PascalABC.NET using LINQ with both sequential and parallel execution for performance comparison.
Solve the knapsack problem in PascalABC.NET using backtracking to find all subsets of items that exactly fill the knapsack capacity.
Create PascalABC.NET programs that demonstrate DLL usage, including calling functions and accessing variables from external libraries.
Build a LEGO structure in 3D using Graph3D in PascalABC.NET with different colored blocks stacked on top of each other.
Compare performance between array and list operations in PascalABC.NET by measuring execution time for large-scale element assignments.
Send an email using System.Net.Mail in PascalABC.NET with proper SMTP server configuration and message formatting.
Demonstrate lambda expression syntax in PascalABC.NET showing different ways to write procedure assignments with side effects.
Create fractal visualizations in PascalABC.NET using the Paporotnik library to draw multiple fractal patterns in a single window.
Measure performance of list slicing operations in PascalABC.NET by timing repeated slice operations on large lists.
Benchmark list slice assignment performance in PascalABC.NET by timing repeated slice assignments on lists.
